transcript: Can you check my internet speed?
response:
I cannot directly measure your internet speed as I do not have access to your local network hardware. To check your connection, you can visit a reliable speed testing website such as Fast.com, Speedtest.net, or use the official MySpeed tool provided by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India.

Would you like me to explain what specific metrics like download, upload, and ping mean for your connection quality?
